name: pantrist-ha-integration
description: Pantrist Home Assistant Custom Integration — release tooling

scripts.postrelease: git push --follow-tags origin HEAD && npm run release:gh
scripts.release:gh: TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0); awk '/^### \[|^## \[/{c++} c==1' CHANGELOG.md | gh release create "$TAG" --title "$TAG" --notes-file -
